text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a staged weight smoothing rollout for router -> edged-proxy tonight during the quiet window. Target version is v2.3.1-rc3. Start 20:00 UTC, window 20m. Strategy: 25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100% in 5m steps with 2m observation. Pin canary backend group to avoid cross-region drift. @jordan @maria please ack and confirm probes.

jordan: Ack. Can you paste the exact rollout commands and health probe thresholds?

alex: Plan below (quick):
```
# routerctl traffic shift --route edged-proxy --from v2.3.0 --to v2.3.1-rc3 
# weights: 25,50,75,100
# wait 120s observe -> continue
# health checks: 5xx rate < 0.5% and p95 latency delta < +30ms
```
Will also set session-affinity=sticky for this route during the window.

maria: Sticky sessions OK. Add a temporary leak detection tag and disable autoscale up for the window so we don't overserve. Also add a canary log filter: `level:warning` for the canary group.

ops-rotation: FYI, I'll be watching p95 and error rate, will call rollback if p95 > +60ms or errors > 1% sustained for 3m.

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by alex at 2025-11-22T20:00:12Z — release id r-20251122-2145 — starting step 1 -> 25% weight. Logs: https://deploys.internal/r-20251122-2145

ops-rotation: Observability ping: p95 +12ms, 5xx at 0.1% — nominal so far.

deploy-bot: Step 2 scheduled in 7m. Health checks OK for canary backends.

jordan: Noting a small spike in connection churn on one edge node (eu-west1-edge-03). Might be old cert rotation coinciding. Can we hold at 25% while I verify?

alex: Hold at 25% for now. Freezing automated steps. Thanks @jordan.

maria: I can patch the cert on eu-west1-edge-03 in place, should take ~3m. Doing now.

ops-rotation: p95 holding, errors flat. Good to wait for cert patch.

maria: Patch done. eu-west1-edge-03 cert rotated and restarted. Re-testing.

ops-rotation: Re-test green. p95 back to baseline. Recommend resume to 50%.

alex: Resuming. moving to 50% now.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift update: 50% applied. Health: 5xx 0.12%, p95 +18ms.

jordan: Seeing a micro-bump on long-tail (p99) for one route variant, but not widespread. Suggest we enable KV-cache warmup for canary group before hitting 75%.

alex: Good call. Enabling cache-warmup job now for canary group (one-off): `jobs/kvcache-warmup --group canary-v2.3.1-rc3 --duration 180s`

deploy-bot: KV warmup job started.

ops-rotation: After warmup, p99 normalized. recommend proceed to 75%.

alex: Moving to 75%.

deploy-bot: 75% applied. Health: 5xx 0.1%, p95 +22ms. No rollback triggered.

jordan: Confirming session-affinity still pinned. Verified cookies intact.

maria: Adding release note snippet to the changelog: "router: staged smoothing rollout v2.3.1-rc3 — improved connection handling and cache warmup behavior" Link: https://confluence/internal/releases/2025-11-22-v231rc3

ops-rotation: Final check: if p95 stays < +30ms for 10m we go to 100%. Otherwise, hold and investigate.

alex: Agreed. Watching.

deploy-bot: 10m observation complete, metrics steady. Moving to 100%.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift complete — 100% routed to v2.3.1-rc3. Post-shift health checks OK. Rollout successful.

ops-rotation: Closing watch — no rollback needed. Marking as monitored for 2h. :white_check_mark:

jordan: Nice. Will follow up with a short postmortem if we see any delayed regressions.

maria: Thanks everyone. Logged release notes and pinned the route config to `v2.3.1-rc3` in infra repo.

alex: Thanks team — smooth evening window.

deploy-bot: Note: if you need to revert, run `routerctl traffic shift --route edged-proxy --from v2.3.1-rc3 --to v2.3.0 --immediate` — manual rollback recommended with page ops first.
